paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah thu agen a,
heading: Piang Masa Latna
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Piang masapen tengteng, Israel suante lak a sul hong peuhmah, mihing hi in ganta hitaleh siangthou in sehtuamsak in, kei' a ahi," achi hi.
english: “Sanctify to me all the firstborn, whatever opens the womb among the children of Israel, both of man and of animal. It is mine.”

paite: Mosi in mite kiang ah, "Hiai ni theigige un, Aigupta gam a pan na hong pawtkhiak ni uh, saltanna inn a pan na hong pawtkhiak ni uh ahi; TOUPA'N khut thahat a hiai mun hon tun lah ahi ngal a. Tanghou silngou soh nek louh ding ahi.
heading: Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh Ankuang
english: Moses said to the people, “Remember this day, in which you came out of Egypt, out of the house of bondage; for by strength of hand Yahweh brought you out from this place. No leavened bread shall be eaten.

paite: Hiai ni, Abib kha in na hong paikhia uhi.
english: Today you go out in the month Abib.

paite: Hichi ahong hi ding a, TOUPA'N Kanaante, Hitte, Amorte, Hivte leh Jebuste gam nou hon piak dia, na pipute uh kiang a, akichiamna, bawngnawi leh khuaizu a luang gam ahon tut chiang in, hiai biakna thilzek hiai kha in na tang ding uhi.
english: It shall be, when Yahweh brings you into the land of the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Amorite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite, which he swore to your fathers to give you, a land flowing with milk and honey, that you shall keep this service in this month.

paite: Ni sagih sung tanghou silngou soh louh na ne ding ua, ani sagih ni in TOUPA a ding in ankuangluina a-om ding ahi.
english: Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, and in the seventh day shall be a feast to Yahweh.

paite: Ni sagih sung tanghou silngou soh louh akine dia; na kiang uah tanghou silngou soh akimu ding ahi kei. Na omna tengteng uah leng silngou muh in a-om ding ahi kei hi.
english: Unleavened bread shall be eaten throughout the seven days; and no leavened bread shall be seen with you. No yeast shall be seen with you, within all your borders.

paite: Huai ni in na tapa na hilh ding a, 'Aigupta gam a pan ka hong paikhiak lai a TOUPA'N kei a dia athilhih ziak a hiai kihih ahi' na chi ding hi.
english: You shall tell your son in that day, saying, ‘It is because of that which Yahweh did for me when I came out of Egypt.’

paite: Na ban ah nang a ding in chiamtehna ahi dia, na mitte kikal ah theihgigena, huchi a na kam a TOUPA dan a-omtheihna ding in TOUPA'N ban thahat a Aigupta gam a pan noute ahon pikhiak ziak in.
english: It shall be for a sign to you on your hand, and for a memorial between your eyes, that Yahweh’s law may be in your mouth; for with a strong hand Yahweh has brought you out of Egypt.

paite: Huaiziak in kum teng in ahunbi in hiai dan thuseh na zui ding uh ahi."
english: You shall therefore keep this ordinance in its season from year to year.

paite: "Huan hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA'N, nang kiang leh na pipute kiang a, akichiam bang a, Kanaante gam ahon tut chiang in, hiai ahon piak chiang in,
heading: Piang Masa
english: “It shall be, when Yahweh brings you into the land of the Canaanite, as he swore to you and to your fathers, and will give it to you,

paite: TOUPA a ding in sul hong tengteng na koihtuam ding a, na neih ganta a pan hong om, anou masapen teng; apate TOUPA a ahi ding uhi.
english: that you shall set apart to Yahweh all that opens the womb, and every firstborn that comes from an animal which you have. The males shall be Yahweh’s.

paite: Sabiltungnou masapen teng belamnou in na tankhe dia; huchi a na tatkhiak keileh, angawng na hektan ding. Na tapate lak a mihing tapa masa tengteng na tankhe ding ahi.
english: Every firstborn of a donkey you shall redeem with a lamb; and if you will not redeem it, then you shall break its neck; and you shall redeem all the firstborn of man among your sons.

paite: Hun hong tung ding ah hichi ahi ding a, na tapa in, 'hiai bang ahia? chi a hon dot chiang in, nang akiang ah, ban thahat in TOUPA'N Aigupta gam a pan, koltanna inn a pan ahon lakheta' akiang ah na chi ding uhi.
english: It shall be, when your son asks you in time to come, saying, ‘What is this?’ that you shall tell him, ‘By strength of hand Yahweh brought us out from Egypt, from the house of bondage.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Pharaoh in genhaktak a hon paisak nop louh lai in, TOUPA'N Aigupta gam a piang masa tengteng, mihing apiang masate leh ganta apiang masate athat hi. Huaiziak in pasal, sul hong tengteng, TOUPA kiang a ka lat ahi ua; himahleh ka tapate lak a piang masa tengteng ka tankhia hi.
english: When Pharaoh stubbornly refused to let us go, Yahweh killed all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both the firstborn of man, and the firstborn of livestock. Therefore I sacrifice to Yahweh all that opens the womb, being males; but all the firstborn of my sons I redeem.’

paite: Huchi in na khut ah chiamtehna ding ahi dia, na mitte kikal a khaukhip ahi ding; TOUPA'N Aigupta gam a pan ban thahat a ahon pikhiak ziak in," na chi ding hi.
english: It shall be for a sign on your hand, and for symbols between your eyes; for by strength of hand Yahweh brought us out of Egypt.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Pharaoh in huai mite apaisak lai in, naizaw mahleh Pathian in Philistiate gam tawn in api kei hi. Pathian in, "Kidouna amuh chiang un mite akisik kha ding ua, Aigupta gam ah akiheikik kha ding uh," achih ziak in.
heading: Meipi Leh Meikuang
english: When Pharaoh had let the people go, God didn’t lead them by the way of the land of the Philistines, although that was near; for God said, “Lest perhaps the people change their minds when they see war, and they return to Egypt”;

paite: Huchi in Pathian in mite apikual a, Tuipi San gamdai lampi tawn in api hi. Huchibang in Aigupta gam a pan Israel suante apawlpawl a kizom in apaitou uhi.
english: but God led the people around by the way of the wilderness by the Red Sea; and the children of Israel went up armed out of the land of Egypt.

paite: Mosi in Joseph guhte apua hi. "Pathian in pel lou in ahong veh dia; hiai a pan ka guhte na puak ding uh ahi," chi a Israel suante chihtaktak a, akichiam ziak in.
english: Moses took the bones of Joseph with him, for he had made the children of Israel swear, saying, “God will surely visit you, and you shall carry up my bones away from here with you.”

paite: Sukkoth a pan azinkheta ua, gamdai zul ah, Etham mun ah agiak uhi.
english: They took their journey from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, in the edge of the wilderness.

paite: TOUPA ama uah sun in meipi khuampi dingh in, amaute lampi a pi ding in apai a; zan in meikuang khuampi dingh in, amaute vakna pe ding in; sun leh zan in apai hi; huchi a sun leh zan a apaitheihna ding un.
english: Yahweh went before them by day in a pillar of cloud, to lead them on their way, and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light, that they might go by day and by night:

paite: Mite ma a pan sun a meipi khuampi dingh hiam ahihkeileh zan a meikuang khuampi dingh alamang ngei kei hi.
english: the pillar of cloud by day, and the pillar of fire by night, didn’t depart from before the people.
